source.name: Wikimedia Commons image metadata for the obsolete-occupations list
source.license: Per image; see LicenseShortName and Artist for each file
source.notes: Images are linked (hotlinked from upload.wikimedia.org), not copied.

steps: One record per Wikipedia obsolete occupation, with description and reason text (Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0) and an image hotlinked from Wikimedia Commons with its credit.

census.series: estimated people per census year from title counts; 'reliable' when based on at least 10 sample records. Jobs with fewer than 10 records across all years get no series (likely false matches).
census.spellings: most common written forms (already thresholded upstream).

transitions: 1910->1920 destinations for the job's OCC1950 category, only when the match is exact, or broader with a specific (non-n.e.c.) category at medium/high confidence, at least 100 linked people, and at least 10 sample records with the job's own title in 1910. Top 8 destinations plus 'Everything else' (which includes suppressed small cells).
Non-occupational OCC1950 codes relabelled in plain language (e.g. 999 -> 'No occupation listed').
